evidence.title: Chamjo | The ultimate UX inspiration hub for local apps and competitors

name: Chamjo
summary: Library of 8000+ screenshots from local mobile apps for UX research and flow benchmarking.
description: A UI research library that curates screenshots from real mobile apps, focused on local apps from Indonesia, the UAE and other markets. Browse flows from login to detailed features to benchmark patterns and gather design references; the free plan covers a limited selection and Pro unlocks the full catalog, priority app requests and an ad-free experience.
contains: apps from Indonesia, the UAE and other markets
flows including payments, banking and delivery services
free plan: few popular apps, limited screenshots
Pro: full catalog, priority app requests, ad-free research
app and region requests accepted from users
